{{Top}}
[[File:Shatterpoint-Scalf-ERC.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Nick Rostu]], [[Liane Trevval|Chalk]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in a jungle on [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]]]]
{{Quote|The jungles of Haruun Kal are the galaxy's sole source of thyssel bark, as well as portaak leaf, jinsol, tyruun, and lammas. Among others.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Shatterpoint (novel)">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>}}
A '''jungle''' was a type of [[Forest/Legends|forest]] that was situated within areas with hot climate and contained a large diversity of [[Species/Legends|lifeforms]].<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref>
